gossip.content: A cattle buyer on the village road yesterday afternoon was paying good money for yearlings.

task.description: Tell Peig Hannigan at the Letter Office to hold any letter that comes for the Connollys until Róisín calls for it.
task.assigned: Róisín asks the player to carry the message and the player agrees.
task.in_progress: The player is at the Letter Office with the task still assigned.
task.completed: The player gives Róisín's message to Peig at the Letter Office.
task.afterwards: Peig and Róisín speak of the message as delivered.
